transitDefinition: SkyTrain 图层显示 Expo、Millennium 和 Canada 三条运营线路与 54 座车站（包括 Capstan），采用 TransLink 官方 GTFS 的 2026-11-06 运营快照。线路直接取自班次形状，换乘站按官方 parent station 合并；不表示实时班次、服务中断或步行入口。Broadway Subway 与 Surrey–Langley 扩建尚未开放，不画作运营线路；不包括 SeaBus 或 West Coast Express。

definitionsEn.transitDefinition: The SkyTrain layer shows the operating Expo, Millennium and Canada lines and 54 stations, including Capstan, from the official TransLink GTFS service snapshot for 2026-11-06. Routes use actual trip shapes and interchange platforms are grouped by official parent station. This is not live arrival, disruption or walking-entrance information. The Broadway Subway and Surrey–Langley extensions are not yet open and are not shown as operating lines. SeaBus and West Coast Express are excluded.
